# Architecture and module boundaries

- **Control**. REPO_CONTRACT governs scope, authority, vocabulary, and status evidence. AGENTS and CONTRIBUTING constrain changes. The document register distinguishes controlled designs, evidence, and informative navigation. ([`REPO_CONTRACT.md:62`](../../../REPO_CONTRACT.md#L62), [`AGENTS.md:32`](../../../AGENTS.md#L32), [`docs/00_control/003_document_register.md:16`](../../00_control/003_document_register.md#L16))
- **Codebook**. The codebook generator loads and structurally checks the source CSV, renders the manual, and either writes it or checks drift. Edit source definitions rather than the generated manual. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:44`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L44), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:73`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L73), [`CODEBOOK.md:19`](../../../CODEBOOK.md#L19))
- **Configuration and extraction**. common.py loads strict JSON/configuration and fails explicitly when jsonschema is unavailable. normalise.py checks the frozen source, builds lossless derived tables plus a review queue/manifest, and guards write/check output paths. ([`lit_pattern/common.py:34`](../../../lit_pattern/common.py#L34), [`lit_pattern/common.py:63`](../../../lit_pattern/common.py#L63), [`lit_pattern/common.py:12`](../../../lit_pattern/common.py#L12), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:23`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L23), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:146`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L146))
- **Annotation validation**. validate.py checks the fresh catalogue, applies the local JSON Schema, then verifies record references, versions, locators, absence inspection, positive pattern rules, events, and retained adjudication inputs. It reports actual supplied counts without adding missing annotations. ([`lit_pattern/validate.py:233`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L233), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:40`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L40), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:166`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L166), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:247`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L247))
- **External configuration and schemas**. config/pipeline.json owns source/version/vocabulary and evidence rules. schemas holds the configuration and annotation schemas. requirements pins the direct schema-validation dependency. ([`config/pipeline.json:6`](../../../config/pipeline.json#L6), [`config/pipeline.json:64`](../../../config/pipeline.json#L64), [`schemas/annotation.schema.json:216`](../../../schemas/annotation.schema.json#L216), [`requirements.txt:1`](../../../requirements.txt#L1))
- **Derived data and semantic boundaries**. data/normalised is reproducible extraction, including exact source bytes. Indicator cells, untyped relation pairs, and workbook mapping cells remain explicit candidates/review work; configured typed relations are separate. ([`lit_pattern/normalise.py:125`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L125), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:126`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L126), [`lit_pattern/normalise.py:133`](../../../lit_pattern/normalise.py#L133), [`docs/30_design/304_annotation_file_contract.md:83`](../../30_design/304_annotation_file_contract.md#L83), [`.gitattributes:2`](../../../.gitattributes#L2))
- **Verification**. tests uses real CLI subprocesses and invented cases to test generation, negative failure paths, absence counts, timestamps, versions, and source preservation. It supplies conformance evidence rather than reliability or agreement results. ([`tests/test_normalise.py:15`](../../../tests/test_normalise.py#L15), [`tests/test_annotations.py:48`](../../../tests/test_annotations.py#L48), [`tests/test_annotations.py:87`](../../../tests/test_annotations.py#L87))
- **Design and pilot boundary**. Product/use-case documents describe intended work; the model and pilot retain proposed semantics. The file contract and verification record distinguish implemented tooling from SQL, platform, and empirical work still open. ([`docs/10_product/102_use_cases.md:25`](../../10_product/102_use_cases.md#L25), [`docs/30_design/301_normalised_data_model.md:19`](../../30_design/301_normalised_data_model.md#L19), [`PILOT.md:20`](../../../PILOT.md#L20), [`docs/30_design/304_annotation_file_contract.md:159`](../../30_design/304_annotation_file_contract.md#L159))
